observed_trace_validation.scope: Observed candidate availability and target choice only; no measured alternate-policy speedup or source-content age
observed_trace_validation.continuity_scope: Successful projection submissions only; schema 1/2 does not record every render attempt. Target gaps establish only compatibility with intervening renders, not their count or outcome.
observed_trace_validation.warning: Higher frame ID or target is not proof of a newer application scene or physical display time

limitations: Application frame identity is not a simulation or input epoch.
Host monotonic callbacks are not photon or client clock times.
Accepted compositor input is not proof of encoded delivery.
Projection target matching does not establish layer ownership when targets coincide.
Trace adds atomic and clock-read overhead; do not use for promotion.

assumptions: Exact nearest-rank p95 over the finite declared phase grid and fixed minimum count; no continuous phase optimum.
Every larger allowed count can delete its worst-age choices down to minimum count while preserving order/admission; nearest-rank p95 cannot increase.
The minimum full-window count is sufficient for cadence, not necessary for shorter endpoint intervals; lower counts are outside this bound.
All intermediate exact-count solver paths are independently audited; final passing and adjacent failing thresholds establish the integer optimum.
Unlimited known-pair ownership, earlier use of later-observed metadata and fixed shifted runtime timing remain relaxed.
Source application identities do not establish distinct simulation/input epochs or optical freshness.
Future-target ceilings use original runtime inputs; no feedback, pose quality or actual XR acceptance is modeled.
Every participating eye, including alpha if present, is ready at its own recorded receive timestamp; pair readiness is their maximum and age retains the original minimum stereo-eye receipt.
Zero receive-to-publication delay is an optimistic bound over recorded supply, not a decoder, native policy or measured removable cost.

Any hypothetical publication improvement constrained not to precede each original eye receipt has a subset of these eligible edges; its minimum attainable p95 cannot be smaller at the same phase/identity/target constraints.
Original network receipts, source targets and fixed shifted runtime schedule remain unchanged; earlier source generation or transport receipt is outside this bound.
